description: The pinned DirectX Shader Compiler (RFC 0024): the Linux release checks every HLSL artifact at build time (tools/render/shader_artifacts.py hlsl_compile), and the Windows release's dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll are the Direct3D 12 adapter's runtime compiler (render/device/d3d12/pipelines.cpp). tools/render/shader_toolchain.py dxc_release owns fetching (the release asset over HTTPS, bounded by the pinned size), sha256 verification and extraction into dependencies/shader-toolchain/<directory>.
